'''Mixer''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was stationed aboard the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] to protect [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] from assassination attempts. While he was in the cargo bay, he, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and fellow trooper [[Redeye/Legends|Redeye]] were attacked by [[Assassin probe/Legends|assassin probes]]. Redeye was killed first and Mixer was killed soon after discovering Redeye's dropped [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Mixer had two blue crescent markings on his helmet, which was discovered by R2 before he ran into Cody and Rex.

==Behind the scenes==
Mixer first appeared in "[[Voyage of Temptation]]." Like all clones, he was portrayed and voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. In "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]," a clone trooper with similar markings can be seen. However since Mixer died in "Voyage of Temptation", it's definitely not him.
